title: Swap stdout and stderr
summary: Exchange descriptors 1 and 2 with dup and dup2, the way you swap two variables.
hints: Swapping two integers needs a temporary: `tmp = dup(1)` saves the original standard output under a new number.

Then `dup2(2, 1)` makes 1 refer to the old stderr, `dup2(tmp, 2)` makes 2 refer to the old stdout, and `close(tmp)` removes the helper. Write with `write(1, ...)` and `write(2, ...)`: no buffering to think about.
